controls.title: Minimalna duljina lozinke
controls.description: Određuje najmanji broj znakova koji lozinka mora imati. Dužu lozinku puno je teže pogoditi ili probiti.
controls.impact: Kod sljedeće promjene lozinke korisnici moraju odabrati dužu lozinku; postojeće lozinke i PIN i dalje rade.

benchmarks.recommendation: 14 ili više znakova
14 ili više znakova

controls.notes: secedit [System Access] applies to LOCAL (SAM) accounts. Domain accounts take password policy only from a GPO linked at the domain root (or Fine-Grained Password Policies); an OU-linked GPO only changes local accounts of the member computers. In domain mode these keys must go into the GPO's GptTmpl.inf - Set-GPRegistryValue cannot write them. A 16-character option was removed on purpose: (1) its RelaxMinimumPasswordLengthLimits value is owned by accounts.relax-length-limit, and Test-GpsControlCatalog rejects two controls writing the same value (selecting len-8/12/14 would also emit an implied Delete of it, undoing accounts.relax-length-limit); (2) Invoke-GpsLocalApplyCore writes Registry.pol, runs secedit, and only then gpupdate, so on a first apply MinimumPasswordLength > 14 reaches secedit before the SAM relax value exists and the import fails (taking the lockout/complexity keys of the same INF with it); (3) Windows LAPS rotation fails when the LAPS PasswordLength is below the local minimum. Machines already at 15+ still read as len-14 (atLeast). If a 15/16 option is re-added later: no registry settings in it, require accounts.relax-length-limit = on, and apply the SAM value before secedit. Microsoft/Entra accounts and Windows Hello PINs are not affected. NIST SP 800-63B-4 suggests 15+ for single-factor passwords.

controls.title: Složene lozinke
controls.description: Lozinka mora sadržavati znakove iz barem tri skupine (velika slova, mala slova, brojke, posebni znakovi) i ne smije sadržavati korisničko ime. Takve lozinke teže je pogoditi.
controls.impact: Kod sljedeće promjene lozinke jednostavne lozinke poput 'ljeto2026' više se ne prihvaćaju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno
Uključeno

controls.notes: Local default on stand-alone Windows 11 is Disabled. Enforced only at the next password change. NIST SP 800-63B discourages composition rules, but both CIS and MSB still require this, so it is on at every level. CIS v5.1.0 (Sept 2026) is reported (CIS/BigFix release notes, quoted in the network research) to have UPDATED the password complexity recommendation; what changed was not verified. Re-check 1.1.5 before moving references from v5.0.1 to v5.1.0.

controls.title: Bez ponavljanja starih lozinki
controls.description: Windows pamti zadnje 24 lozinke i ne dopušta njihovo ponovno korištenje. Stara, možda otkrivena lozinka tako se ne vraća u upotrebu.
controls.impact: Pri promjeni lozinke korisnik ne može ponovno upotrijebiti neku od prethodnih lozinki.

benchmarks.recommendation: Pamti se 24 ili više lozinki
Pamti se 24 lozinke

controls.notes: Only meaningful together with accounts.password-min-age (otherwise a user can change the password 24 times in a row and return to the old one).

controls.title: Najduže trajanje lozinke
controls.description: Nakon zadanog broja dana Windows traži novu lozinku. Današnje preporuke savjetuju rijetke promjene, a lozinku treba odmah promijeniti ako postoji sumnja da je otkrivena.
controls.impact: Korisnici jednom godišnje (ili svakih 90 dana) moraju smisliti novu lozinku, a tko se prijavljuje PIN-om tada mora znati i staru lozinku.

benchmarks.recommendation: 365 dana ili manje, ali ne 0 (lozinka mora jednom isteći)

controls.notes: MSB deliberately does NOT configure password expiration since the Windows 10 1903 baseline (Microsoft: periodic expiration is 'an ancient and obsolete mitigation of very low value'); NIST SP 800-63B also rejects forced periodic changes. days-90 is offered only for regulatory needs (e.g. PCI DSS when the password is the only factor) and is not used by any level. In secedit -1 means 'never expires' and 0 is also 'never' in the UI; atMost (0 < actual <= ours) correctly reads both as non-compliant. Keep MinimumPasswordAge < MaximumPasswordAge. Reading state: the Windows local default MaximumPasswordAge is 42 days, so an untouched PC matches both options under atMost and is shown as 'days-90' (strictest match). Accounts flagged 'Password never expires' are not affected; a password already older than the new limit must be changed at the next sign-in.

controls.title: Najkraće trajanje lozinke
controls.description: Nova lozinka mora vrijediti barem jedan dan prije sljedeće promjene. Tako korisnik ne može u nekoliko brzih promjena vratiti staru lozinku.
controls.impact: Nakon promjene lozinke korisnik je ne može ponovno promijeniti idućih 24 sata; administrator je po potrebi može resetirati.

benchmarks.recommendation: 1 dan ili više

controls.notes: Not part of MSB. Works together with password history.

controls.title: Bez čitljivo spremljenih lozinki
controls.description: Windows nikada ne sprema lozinke na način iz kojega se mogu vratiti u izvorni tekst. Takvo spremanje gotovo je isto kao lozinka zapisana na papiriću.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Isključeno spremanje lozinki uz povratnu enkripciju
Isključeno spremanje lozinki uz povratnu enkripciju

controls.notes: Windows default is already 0; setting it explicitly guards against legacy CHAP/IIS digest configurations re-enabling it.

controls.title: Lozinke duže od 14 znakova
controls.description: Uklanja staro ograničenje prema kojem pravilo minimalne duljine lozinke ne može tražiti više od 14 znakova. Bez ove postavke ne može se zadati strože pravilo duljine.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno

controls.notes: Security Options value (Windows 10 2004+/Server 2022+). Has no effect by itself; it only allows MinimumPasswordLength > 14 (see accounts.password-length len-16). Not part of MSB. CIS 1.1.6 number inferred from v5.0.1 1.1.5/1.1.7 being confirmed and v4.0.0 order.

controls.title: Zaključavanje nakon pogrešnih lozinki
controls.description: Nakon nekoliko pogrešno upisanih lozinki račun se privremeno zaključava. To zaustavlja napadače koji pokušavaju pogoditi lozinku.
controls.impact: Tko više puta pogrešno upiše lozinku, mora pričekati 10 do 15 minuta ili zamoliti administratora da otključa račun.

benchmarks.recommendation: Najviše 5 pogrešnih pokušaja (ne 0); zaključavanje traje 15 ili više minuta; brojač se poništava nakon 15 ili više minuta
10 pokušaja, zaključavanje 10 minuta, brojač se poništava nakon 10 minuta

controls.notes: Per-key matchModes (supported by Get-GpsMatchMode in SecurityControls.ps1): LockoutBadCount atMost (0 < actual <= ours), LockoutDuration/ResetLockoutCount atLeast, so a stricter PC (e.g. 3 attempts / 30 min) reads as cis-5 instead of 'not configured'; a PC at 5/15/15 matches both options and the strictest (cis-5) wins. LockoutDuration -1 (until an admin unlocks) does not match atLeast and reads as not configured. MSB counts cis-5 as satisfying because the MSB checks used by HardeningKitty/AuditTAP are threshold <= 10 and durations >= 10; a literal diff (Policy Analyzer) will still show a difference. secedit rules: ResetLockoutCount must be <= LockoutDuration and durations are ignored when LockoutBadCount = 0, so write LockoutBadCount first. Windows 11 22H2+ already ships 10/10/10 as the local default. Both standards also require 'Allow Administrator account lockout' = Enabled (secedit AllowAdministratorLockout = 1, CIS 1.2.3): default on Win11 22H2+, but the key is not in the allowed security key list - consider adding it. Domain accounts follow the domain-root policy only. Windows Hello PIN has its own TPM anti-hammering.

controls.title: Isključen račun Gost
controls.description: Ugrađeni račun Gost omogućuje ulazak bez lozinke. Kad je isključen, nitko se ne može anonimno prijaviti na računalo.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju jer je račun Gost u Windowsima 11 obično već isključen.

benchmarks.recommendation: Račun Gost isključen

controls.notes: Not in MSB (disabled by default). The CIS 'rename guest/administrator account' items are omitted because they need free-text input.

controls.title: Prazne lozinke samo lokalno
controls.description: Lokalni računi bez lozinke mogu se prijaviti samo izravno na računalu, a ne preko mreže ili udaljene radne površine. Tako prazna lozinka ne otvara računalo napadaču s mreže.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno
Uključeno

controls.notes: Windows default is already 1; explicit value protects against tools that relax it.

controls.title: Automatsko zaključavanje zaslona
controls.description: Ako nitko ne koristi računalo zadano vrijeme, Windows zaključava zaslon. Tako nitko drugi ne može raditi na računalu dok je korisnik odsutan.
controls.impact: Nakon razdoblja neaktivnosti korisnik ponovno upisuje lozinku ili PIN.

benchmarks.recommendation: 900 sekundi (15 min) ili manje, ali ne 0
900 sekundi (15 min)

controls.notes: Security option 'Interactive logon: Machine inactivity limit'. Microsoft Learn states a restart is required. 0 or empty disables it; maximum 599940. CIS item was 2.3.7.4 in v4.0.0 and is 2.3.7.3 in v5.0.1 (the BitLocker 'Machine account lockout threshold' item no longer sits before it). MSB literally specifies 900; stricter values are counted as satisfying, though literal-diff tools will flag 600/300.

controls.title: Skrivanje zadnjeg korisnika
controls.description: Zaslon za prijavu ne prikazuje ime osobe koja se zadnja prijavila. Napadač tako ne dobiva unaprijed pola podataka potrebnih za prijavu.
controls.impact: Korisnici pri svakoj prijavi moraju upisati i korisničko ime, a ne samo lozinku ili PIN.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno (ne prikazuj zadnjeg prijavljenog korisnika)

controls.notes: CIS L1 item intentionally kept out of level 2: it removes the user tile, so staff must type their account name (e.g. AzureAD\name or e-mail) before PIN/password on every sign-in - heavy friction for non-technical users. Not in MSB. Applies at the next sign-in screen, no restart.

controls.title: Prijava uz Ctrl+Alt+Del
controls.description: Prije prijave treba pritisnuti Ctrl+Alt+Del. Tu kombinaciju tipki prima samo Windows, pa lažni zaslon za prijavu ne može ukrasti lozinku.
controls.impact: Prije upisa lozinke ili PIN-a korisnici pritišću Ctrl+Alt+Del.

benchmarks.recommendation: 'Ne traži CTRL+ALT+DEL' isključeno, tj. tipke su obavezne

controls.notes: Moved from Level 1 (v4.0.0) to Level 2 in CIS v5.x (listed in the v5.0.1 benchmark as L2 and present in Tenable's v5.1.0 L2-only audit). Not in MSB. On keyboard-less tablets the secure attention sequence is Win+Power. Microsoft notes reverting requires removing the DisableCAD value, not just 'Not defined'.

controls.title: Automatska ažuriranja Windowsa
controls.description: Windows sam preuzima i instalira sigurnosne zakrpe čim izađu, bez odgode. Tako računalo uvijek ima najnoviju zaštitu.
controls.impact: Ako računalo ostane uključeno, nakon ažuriranja može se samo ponovno pokrenuti izvan radnog vremena, obično noću.

benchmarks.recommendation: Automatska ažuriranja uključena (bilo koja opcija osim isključivanja); Dan zakazane instalacije: svaki dan; Staro pravilo 'Bez automatskog restarta dok je korisnik prijavljen' isključeno; Sigurnosne (kvalitativne) zakrpe bez odgode: 0 dana

controls.notes: Option values match what the GP editor writes for 'Configure Automatic Updates' option 4 (auto download + scheduled install, every day 03:00, every week) or option 3 (auto download, notify to install). Element names were checked against the Windows 11 25H2 WindowsUpdate.admx (AutoUpdateCfg: AUOptions, AutomaticMaintenanceEnabled, ScheduledInstallDay, ScheduledInstallTime, AllowMUUpdateService, ScheduledInstall*Week). The GP editor writes the schedule elements whatever option is chosen. The quality-update deferral (DeferQualityUpdates=1, DeferQualityUpdatesPeriodInDays=0 = CIS 'Select when Quality Updates are received: Enabled 0 days') is merged in. It is a WUfB policy, so WSUS-managed devices ignore it. NoAutoRebootWithLoggedOnUsers=0 is the CIS L1 'Disabled' state of a legacy policy. If it were Enabled (1), the ADMX says the active-hours policy would stop working. IMPORTANT interaction: the ADMX explain text of 'Specify deadline for automatic updates and restarts' says it overrides 'Configure Automatic Updates'. updates.deadlines is on at every level, so updates install as soon as they are offered and restarts are attempted outside active hours (updates.active-hours). The 03:00 schedule only really matters when deadlines are not configured, so the impact text was rewritten to be true in both cases. MSB (25H2/26H2) has no Windows Update settings. CIS numbers are v4.0.0 (v3.0.0 used 18.10.92.x, v5.0.x uses 18.10.94.x). AUOptions 5 and 7 are deliberately not offered.

controls.title: Rok za instalaciju i restart
controls.description: Određuje najviše koliko dana smije proći od izlaska zakrpe do njezine instalacije i ponovnog pokretanja. Korisnik može odgađati restart, ali samo do isteka roka.
controls.impact: Kad rok istekne, računalo se ponovno pokreće uz upozorenje, pa i tijekom radnog vremena.
controls.notes: Neither CIS Windows 11 Enterprise nor MSB sets deadlines. Microsoft recommends them so patches actually get installed. Option titles give the quality-update deadline. The feature-update deadline is 14/7/7 days and the grace period is 3/2/1 for both. Value names are confirmed against a parse of the Windows 11 25H2 WindowsUpdate.admx. Policy ComplianceDeadline ('Specify deadline for automatic updates and restarts for quality update') = enable flag SetComplianceDeadlineForQU + ConfigureDeadlineForQualityUpdates (0-30) + ConfigureDeadlineGracePeriod (0-7) + boolean ConfigureDeadlineNoAutoRebootForQualityUpdates. Policy ComplianceDeadlineForFU = SetComplianceDeadlineForFU + ConfigureDeadlineForFeatureUpdates (0-30) + ConfigureDeadlineGracePeriodForFeatureUpdates (0-7) + ConfigureDeadlineNoAutoRebootForFeatureUpdates. All are DWORD (enum elements). The single flag SetComplianceDeadline belongs to the older pre-split ADMX and is NOT in the 25H2 ADMX. It is kept only for clients and central stores that still use the old template. Side effect: a PC configured with the current GP editor has no SetComplianceDeadline, so state detection reports 'not matching' and GPMC shows it as an extra registry setting. Drop it if older templates and Windows 10 do not matter. The NoAutoReboot booleans are left out. Absent means 0: Windows may restart automatically outside active hours before the deadline, which is what Microsoft recommends. Per the ADMX explain text, this policy overrides 'Configure Automatic Updates', 'Always automatically restart at the scheduled time', 'Specify deadline before auto restart' and the engaged-restart policy. Once deadline plus grace period has passed, the restart ignores active hours. matchMode atMost: a shorter deadline already set on the PC counts as compliant. A deadline or grace period of 0 (stricter) reads as not matching, because atMost requires a value above 0.

controls.title: Bez restarta u radno vrijeme
controls.description: Windows neće sam ponovno pokretati računalo između 7 i 19 sati. Ažuriranja se dovršavaju izvan tog vremena.
controls.impact: Restart se događa navečer ili noću (osim kad istekne rok za ažuriranje), a korisnici u postavkama ne mogu sami mijenjati radno vrijeme.
controls.notes: GP 'Turn off auto-restart for updates during active hours' (SetActiveHours=1; ActiveHoursStart/End enum 0-23), checked against the 25H2 WindowsUpdate.admx. The default maximum range is 18 hours; 7-19 is 12. Per the ADMX explain text, the policy has no effect if 'No auto-restart with logged on users' or 'Always automatically restart at scheduled time' is enabled. updates.automatic writes the former as 0 (Disabled), so there is no conflict. While the policy is set, it replaces the user's own active-hours choice in Settings, and users cannot change it. That is why impactLevel is low rather than none. Not in CIS or MSB. Once deadline plus grace period has passed, Windows restarts regardless of active hours.

controls.title: Odgoda velikih nadogradnji
controls.description: Nova godišnja verzija Windowsa stiže tek 180 dana nakon izlaska. Do tada Microsoft ispravi većinu početnih grešaka, a sigurnosne zakrpe i dalje stižu odmah.
controls.impact: Nove mogućnosti Windowsa stižu otprilike pola godine kasnije.

benchmarks.recommendation: Velike nadogradnje odgođene 180 ili više dana

controls.notes: GP 'Select when Preview Builds and Feature Updates are received'. In the current Windows 11 WindowsUpdate.admx (25H2) this policy has only DeferFeatureUpdates (1/0), DeferFeatureUpdatesPeriodInDays (0-365) and PauseFeatureUpdatesStartTime. The BranchReadinessLevel element moved to 'Manage preview builds' (Dev 2, Beta 4, Release Preview 8, RP quality-only 64). BranchReadinessLevel is therefore no longer written, for three reasons. GA deferral does not need it. A PC configured with the GP editor would not have it (false 'not matching'). And under atLeast a higher value such as 128 (Canary channel in the Update CSP) or 64 would wrongly count as compliant. CIS v3 implementations that quote the benchmark (Wazuh SCA, Ansible Lockdown) check only DeferFeatureUpdates=1 and DeferFeatureUpdatesPeriodInDays>=180. HardeningKitty's BranchReadinessLevel=2 (Dev channel) is an error in the list and must never be written. With atLeast, 181-365 days also pass. Deferrals are ignored when a Target Release Version policy is set, and on WSUS-managed devices. The quality-update deferral (0 days, CIS 18.10.93.4.3) is in updates.automatic. Not in MSB.

controls.title: Samo provjerena ažuriranja
controls.description: Računalo ne prima probne (Insider) verzije Windowsa ni neobavezna probna ažuriranja. Nove mogućnosti koje su po zadanom isključene ostaju isključene.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Probne (Insider) verzije onemogućene ('Manage preview builds': Disabled); Neobavezna ažuriranja isključena ('Enable optional updates': Disabled); Novosti iz servisiranja koje su po zadanom isključene ostaju isključene

controls.notes: Three CIS L1 items merged into one switch. (1) Manage preview builds = Disabled. In the Windows 11 WindowsUpdate.admx the policy valueName is ManagePreviewBuildsPolicyValue, with enabledValue 2 and disabledValue 1; the BranchReadinessLevel element is used only when the policy is enabled. So 'Disabled' = ManagePreviewBuildsPolicyValue=1. In the Update CSP, 1 means 'disable preview builds once the next release is public'; per the ADMX text, devices on a pre-release build opt out and stay on the next GA feature update. Wazuh SCA and Ansible Lockdown (both CIS v3.0.0) check or write exactly ManagePreviewBuildsPolicyValue=1. The earlier ManagePreviewBuilds=0 was the old Windows 10 ADMX enable flag: Windows does not treat it as a preview-build block, and the CIS audit does not check it. HardeningKitty's v4 list still checks the Windows 10 form (ManagePreviewBuilds=1 + ManagePreviewBuildsPolicyValue=0); a PC set up that way reads as not matching. (2) Enable optional updates = Disabled: GP 'Disabled' writes SetAllowOptionalContent=0. AllowOptionalContent=0 (CSP: don't receive optional updates) is also written, because CIS audits (Wazuh, HardeningKitty) read that value. (3) Enable features introduced via servicing that are off by default = Disabled: AllowTemporaryEnterpriseFeatureControl=0. CIS number for (3): the CIS v3.0.0 text (Wazuh SCA, Ansible Lockdown) numbers it 18.10.92.2.3, and Tenable numbers it 18.10.94.2.3 for v5.0.1, so the v4.0.0 number is 18.10.93.2.3. The HardeningKitty v3 and v4 lists swap it with 'Remove access to Pause updates'. Not in MSB.

controls.title: Zabrani pauziranje ažuriranja
controls.description: Korisnici ne mogu u postavkama pauzirati ažuriranja na nekoliko tjedana. Tako zakrpe ne kasne zbog zaboravljene pauze.
controls.impact: Gumb za pauziranje ažuriranja u postavkama bit će nedostupan.

benchmarks.recommendation: Ukloniti korisnicima mogućnost pauziranja ažuriranja

controls.notes: GP 'Remove access to "Pause updates" feature' (SetDisablePauseUXAccess=1), checked in the 25H2 WindowsUpdate.admx. CIS number: the CIS v3.0.0 text (Wazuh SCA, Ansible Lockdown) has this item as 18.10.92.2.4 and 'Enable features introduced via servicing' as 18.10.92.2.3. Tenable shows 18.10.94.2.3 = 'Enable features...' for v5.0.1. So the item was not removed in v5; the HardeningKitty v3 and v4 lists simply swap the two numbers. v4.0.0 = 18.10.93.2.4 (v5.x is presumably 18.10.94.2.4, not checked). Not in MSB. Level 1 leaves it unset so small offices are not surprised.

controls.title: USB memorije i memorijske kartice
controls.description: Određuje što zaposlenici smiju raditi s USB memorijama i memorijskim karticama. Zabrana pokretanja programa sprječava da se virus pokrene izravno s USB-a.
controls.impact: Ovisno o izboru: programi se ne pokreću s USB-a, na USB se ne može spremati ili se USB memorije, CD-i i mobiteli spojeni kabelom uopće ne otvaraju; tipkovnice, miševi i pisači rade normalno.
controls.notes: RemovableStorage.admx (System > Removable Storage Access): RemovableDisks_DenyExecute_Access_2 (Machine only, supportedOn Windows 7), RemovableDisks_DenyWrite_Access_2 and RemovableDisks_DenyRead_Access_2 -> HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\RemovableStorageDevices\{53f5630d-b6bf-11d0-94f2-00a0c91efb8b} Deny_Execute/Deny_Write/Deny_Read = DWORD 1. RemovableStorageClasses_DenyAll_Access_2 -> ...\RemovableStorageDevices Deny_All = DWORD 1. Deny_All overrides every class policy and also blocks CD/DVD, floppy, tape and WPD devices such as phones/cameras over MTP. Deny_Read/Deny_Write/Deny_All also exist as User-scope (HKCU) policies; this control manages only the Machine scope. Option 'Dozvoljeno' also deletes Deny_Read, so a value set by another tool is cleared. Restart: the ADML help of AccessRights_RebootTime says 'If no reboot is forced, the access right does not take effect until the operating system is restarted', hence requiresRestart=true. We deliberately do NOT set RebootTimeinSeconds_state/RebootTimeinSeconds, because that forces a reboot. INTERACTION with usb.bitlocker-write: 'Samo čitanje' (Deny_Write) and 'Zabranjeno' (Deny_All) deny writes to EVERY removable disk, including BitLocker To Go drives, so they supersede 'Upis samo na šifrirane USB diskove' (the ADML of RemovableDisks_DenyWrite points to the BitLocker policy as the alternative for encrypted-only writing). For 'write only to encrypted sticks' combine 'Bez pokretanja programa' with usb.bitlocker-write, as the laptop preset (11-prijenosno-racunalo) does. Level 3 keeps 'Samo čitanje' to match the 'Strogo' preset text ('USB samo za čitanje'); usb.bitlocker-write is therefore not enabled at level 3. Neither CIS Windows 11 (L1/L2) nor the Microsoft Security Baseline has Removable Storage Access recommendations; both only use Device Installation restrictions against DMA, which belong to the BitLocker/system group. Deny_Execute stops executables from starting on the medium; it is not full application control. Enterprise alternative: Defender for Endpoint Device Control. Not verified for USB hard disks/SSDs that report as fixed media: test before relying on it.

controls.title: Bez automatskog pokretanja
controls.description: Kad se umetne USB ili CD ili spoji mobitel, Windows ništa ne pokreće sam niti nudi pokretanje. Tako su se nekad širili virusi s USB-a.
controls.impact: Pri umetanju USB-a ne pojavljuje se prozor s ponudom radnji; datoteke se otvaraju ručno u File Exploreru.

benchmarks.recommendation: AutoPlay isključen za sve pogone; AutoRun: ne izvršavati nikakve autorun naredbe; Bez AutoPlaya za uređaje koji nisu diskovi (mobiteli, kamere)
Sve tri AutoPlay/AutoRun postavke isključene, kao u CIS-u

controls.notes: Option id stays 'off' (AutoPlay off) for preset compatibility, but its title is 'Uključeno': for a single-option control the GUI renders the option title as the checkbox label (Gui.Security.ps1), and the catalog convention for 'Bez ...' titles is 'Uključeno' (privacy.advertising, privacy.feedback-logs). A box labelled 'ISKLJUČENO' next to 'Bez automatskog pokretanja' reads as switching the protection off. AutoPlay.admx: policy 'Autorun' (Turn off Autoplay) is an enum NoDriveTypeAutoRun: 181 = CD-ROM and removable, 255 = All drives. Policy 'NoAutorun' (Set the default behavior for AutoRun) is an enum: 1 = Do not execute any autorun commands, 2 = Automatically execute. Both live under Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\Explorer and are class Both (also HKCU); CIS/MSB check the HKLM values, which is what we write. NoAutoplayfornonVolume (Disallow Autoplay for non-volume devices, MTP phones/cameras) is under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer. Item numbers are CIS v4.0.0 (HardeningKitty v4.0.0 list); L1 in v3.0.0 (Wazuh SCA, 18.10.7.1-3) and v5.0.1 (Fleet). requiresRestart=false: Explorer re-reads shell restrictions after the policy-change broadcast; a signed-in session may rarely need a sign-out.

controls.title: Upis samo na šifrirane USB diskove
controls.description: Na USB disk se može spremati samo ako je zaštićen BitLockerom. Ako se disk izgubi ili ukrade, podaci na njemu ostaju nečitljivi.
controls.impact: Nešifrirani USB diskovi otvaraju se samo za čitanje, a Windows nudi da ih korisnik šifrira; takav disk se ne može čitati na Macu, televizoru ili pisaču.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno, bez zabrane upisa na diskove šifrirane u drugoj organizaciji

controls.notes: VolumeEncryption.admx policy RDVDenyWriteAccess_Name (BitLocker Drive Encryption > Removable Data Drives > Deny write access to removable drives not protected by BitLocker) writes RDVDenyWriteAccess under System\CurrentControlSet\Policies\Microsoft\FVE (NOT Software\Policies). The policy also has a REQUIRED boolean element RDVCrossOrg, written as RDVDenyCrossOrg under Software\Policies\Microsoft\FVE. Value 0 means 'Do not allow write access to devices configured in another organization' is unchecked. MSB 25H2/26H2 (BitLocker GPO): RDVDenyWriteAccess=1, RDVDenyCrossOrg=0. CIS has it only in the BitLocker (BL) profile, not in L1/L2: v4.0.0 18.10.10.3.14 (Enabled) and 18.10.10.3.15 (cross-org False); v3.0.0 18.10.9.3.14/.15 (BL). Therefore there is no CIS-L1/L2 entry. LEVELS: not enabled at any level. Level 3 selects usb.storage 'Samo čitanje' (Deny_Write on the Removable Disks class), which blocks writing to every removable disk, BitLocker-protected or not, so this policy would add nothing there except a BitLocker prompt, and even an encrypted stick would stay read-only. Use it together with usb.storage 'Bez pokretanja programa' (e.g. the laptop preset 11-prijenosno-racunalo) when encrypted sticks must stay writable. A level-3 compliance report will therefore show this MSB item as not met, although 'Samo čitanje' is stricter. Creating a BitLocker To Go drive needs Windows Pro/Enterprise/Education. Takes effect when a drive is inserted again; no restart.
controls.requirement: BitLocker: Windows Pro, Enterprise ili Education.

controls.title: Zaštita u stvarnom vremenu
controls.description: Defender stalno provjerava datoteke, preuzimanja, privitke i skripte dok se koriste. Postavka drži zaštitu uključenom, pa je korisnik ne može isključiti.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju; prekidač za zaštitu u aplikaciji Sigurnost sustava Windows je zaključan.

benchmarks.recommendation: Zaštita u stvarnom vremenu ne smije biti isključena; Nadzor ponašanja programa uključen; Provjera svih preuzetih datoteka i privitaka uključena; Provjera skripti uključena; Zaštita i ažuriranja uključeni već tijekom prvog postavljanja računala
Sva zaštita u stvarnom vremenu uključena, nadzor u oba smjera i automatsko uklanjanje prijetnji

controls.notes: WindowsDefender.admx: DisableRealtimeMonitoring (Turn off real-time protection; Disabled = 0). RealtimeProtection_DisableBehaviorMonitoring / _DisableIOAVProtection / _DisableSriptScanning / _DisableOnAccessProtection / _DisableScanOnRealtimeEnable (Enabled = 0). RealtimeScanDirection enum (0 = incoming and outgoing). OobeEnableRtpAndSigUpdate = 1 (newer ADMX; path taken from the CIS/MSB lists). DisableRoutinelyTakingAction (Turn off routine remediation; Disabled = 0). All are under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender[\Real-Time Protection]. CIS-L1 covers the first five values; MSB 25H2/26H2 covers all nine. The values only lock protection ON; Tamper Protection is unaffected. If a third-party antivirus is installed, Defender runs passive and these values have no effect. CIS numbering is v4.0.0 (section 18.10.43). In v5.0.1 the Defender section is 18.10.42 (e.g. 18.10.42.10.3). v5.1.0 moved all Defender Antivirus items to the separate CIS Microsoft Defender Antivirus Benchmark v1.0.0.

controls.title: Provjera USB diskova
controls.description: Kod potpunog skeniranja Defender provjerava i umetnute USB memorije i kartice, a ne samo disk računala.
controls.impact: Potpuno skeniranje traje malo dulje kad je USB umetnut.

benchmarks.recommendation: Skeniranje prijenosnih diskova uključeno
Skeniranje prijenosnih diskova uključeno

controls.notes: WindowsDefender.admx Scan_DisableRemovableDriveScanning: Enabled writes DisableRemovableDriveScanning = 0 under ...\Windows Defender\Scan. ADML: when not configured, removable drives are not scanned during a FULL scan. Real-time protection still scans files when they are opened. CIS v4.0.0 numbering; v5.1.0 moved Defender items to the CIS Microsoft Defender Antivirus Benchmark.

controls.title: Blokiranje neželjenih programa
controls.description: Defender zaustavlja potencijalno neželjene programe: alatne trake, programe s oglasima, rudare kriptovaluta i dodatke koji se instaliraju uz besplatne programe.
controls.impact: Rijetko se neki besplatni program s dodacima neće instalirati dok ga IT ne odobri.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno: blokiraj
Uključeno: blokiraj

controls.notes: Current location: WindowsDefender.admx policy Root_PUAProtection ('Configure detection for potentially unwanted applications') writes Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender!PUAProtection, enum 0 = off, 1 = block, 2 = audit. The historic location Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\MpEngine!MpEnablePus comes from the Windows 10 1607/1703-era ADMX. It is obsolete and absent from both the current ADMX and the CIS/MSB checks, so it is not written. Microsoft Edge has its own PUA download blocking (SmartScreenPuaEnabled); that belongs to the browser/apps group.

controls.title: Zaštita iz oblaka
controls.description: Defender šalje Microsoftu podatke o sumnjivim datotekama i u nekoliko sekundi dobiva odgovor. Tako prepoznaje i potpuno nove viruse.
controls.impact: Korisnici obično ništa ne primjećuju; uz 'Pojačano' se nova, nepoznata datoteka ponekad otvori tek nakon provjere, što može potrajati do jedne minute.

benchmarks.recommendation: Lokalni administrator ne smije mijenjati postavku slanja podataka Microsoftu
Slanje podataka Microsoftu (MAPS) isključeno, zbog privatnosti
Napredno članstvo u MAPS-u, slanje svih uzoraka, visoka razina blokiranja i produžena provjera do 50 sekundi

controls.notes: CONFLICT between standards. CIS L2 wants 'Join Microsoft MAPS' = Disabled for privacy (v4.0.0 18.10.43.5.2; L2 also in v3.0.0 per Wazuh and in Fleet's v5.0.1 set). MSB 23H2-26H2 wants: Advanced MAPS (SpynetReporting=2); 'Send file samples' = Send all samples (SubmitSamplesConsent=3; 22H2 used 1); Block at First Sight on (DisableBlockAtFirstSeen=0); cloud protection level High (MpCloudBlockLevel=2); extended cloud check 50 s (MpBafsExtendedTimeout=50). With MAPS off, Block at First Sight, cloud-delivered protection and the ASR ransomware rule (c1db55ab) stop working, so 'Isključeno' is offered only for CIS L2 parity and no level uses it. Impact wording: the default cloud check holds a file up to 10 s and MpBafsExtendedTimeout adds up to 50 s, so a first-seen file can be held for up to about a minute, not 'a few seconds'. Detection: matchModes MpCloudBlockLevel=atLeast, because the enum 0/1/2/4/6 grows stricter (4 = High+, 6 = Zero tolerance) and the MSB check itself accepts >= 2; without it a computer at High+ or Zero tolerance would not be recognised as 'Pojačano'. WindowsDefender.admx enums: SpynetReporting 0 Disabled / 1 Basic / 2 Advanced; SubmitSamplesConsent 0 Always prompt / 1 Send safe samples / 2 Never send / 3 Send all samples; MpBafsExtendedTimeout 0-50. The 'Disabled' state of the SpynetReporting policy deletes the value; the CIS audit (Fleet, HardeningKitty '=|0') accepts a missing value or 0, so writing 0 satisfies it. LocalSettingOverrideSpynetReporting=0 is CIS L1 and is part of every option. Privacy: 'Send all samples' may upload documents (e.g. Office files with macros) for analysis; for very sensitive data an admin may prefer 'Uključeno' (safe samples only).

controls.title: Zaštita od opasnih web stranica
controls.description: Blokira spajanje na poznate lažne (phishing) i zaražene web stranice iz bilo kojeg programa, ne samo iz preglednika.
controls.impact: Kad je opasna stranica blokirana, korisnik vidi obavijest; obične stranice rade bez promjene.

settings.key: Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\Network Protection
Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\Network Protection

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno: blokiraj
Upozorenja o opasnim stranicama pretvoriti u blokadu
Uključeno: blokiraj, upozorenja se pretvaraju u blokadu

controls.notes: WindowsDefender.admx ExploitGuard_EnableNetworkProtection: ...\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\Network Protection!EnableNetworkProtection, enum 0 off / 1 block / 2 audit. EnableConvertWarnToBlock (Network Inspection System > Convert warn verdict to block) = 1 under ...\Windows Defender\NIS is a newer ADMX policy. Its path and value come from the CIS v4.0.0 (L2) and MSB 25H2 lists and Fleet v5.0.1. It needs Defender Antivirus active with real-time protection, and reputation lookups rely on cloud protection. Windows Server also needs AllowNetworkProtectionOnWinServer (not relevant for Windows 11).

controls.title: Pravila protiv tipičnih napada (ASR)
controls.description: Sprječava trikove kojima se napadači najčešće služe: Office ili PDF koji pokreće programe, skrivene skripte, krađu lozinki iz memorije i nepotpisane programe s USB-a.
controls.impact: Uglavnom ništa; rijetko stari makro ili dodatak za Office prestane raditi pa ga IT mora izuzeti.

benchmarks.recommendation: Pravila za smanjenje površine napada uključena
13 navedenih pravila u načinu 'Blokiraj'
14 pravila 'Blokiraj' (uključujući zaštitu od ransomwarea), pravilo za PsExec/WMI samo bilježi

controls.notes: Registry: ExploitGuard_ASR_Rules = REG_DWORD 1 under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Windows Defender Exploit Guard\ASR. Each rule is a value named by its GUID under ...\ASR\Rules with REG_SZ data, not DWORD (ADMX <list explicitValue='true'>): '0' off, '1' block, '2' audit, '5' not configured, '6' warn. Options: 'Samo bilježi' = all 15 rules '2'. 'Osnovna zaštita' = Microsoft's three 'standard protection' rules in block and the other 12 in audit, so IT can review events before full block. 'Blokiraj' = 14 rules block + PsExec/WMI audit, which satisfies both CIS L1 (13 rules block) and MSB 25H2/26H2. Rules: 56a863a9-875e-4185-98a7-b882c64b5ce5 = Block abuse of exploited vulnerable signed drivers [MS standard protection, CIS L1 block, MSB block]; 9e6c4e1f-7d60-472f-ba1a-a39ef669e4b2 = Block credential stealing from the Windows local security authority subsystem (lsass.exe) [MS standard protection, CIS L1 block, MSB block]; e6db77e5-3df2-4cf1-b95a-636979351e5b = Block persistence through WMI event subscription [MS standard protection, CIS L1 block, MSB block]; 7674ba52-37eb-4a4f-a9a1-f0f9a1619a2c = Block Adobe Reader from creating child processes [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; d4f940ab-401b-4efc-aadc-ad5f3c50688a = Block all Office applications from creating child processes [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; be9ba2d9-53ea-4cdc-84e5-9b1eeee46550 = Block executable content from email client and webmail [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; 5beb7efe-fd9a-4556-801d-275e5ffc04cc = Block execution of potentially obfuscated scripts [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; d3e037e1-3eb8-44c8-a917-57927947596d = Block JavaScript or VBScript from launching downloaded executable content [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; 3b576869-a4ec-4529-8536-b80a7769e899 = Block Office applications from creating executable content [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; 75668c1f-73b5-4cf0-bb93-3ecf5cb7cc84 = Block Office applications from injecting code into other processes [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; 26190899-1602-49e8-8b27-eb1d0a1ce869 = Block Office communication application from creating child processes [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; b2b3f03d-6a65-4f7b-a9c7-1c7ef74a9ba4 = Block untrusted and unsigned processes that run from USB [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; 92e97fa1-2edf-4476-bdd6-9dd0b4dddc7b = Block Win32 API calls from Office macros [CIS L1 block, MSB block]; c1db55ab-c21a-4637-bb3f-a12568109d35 = Use advanced protection against ransomware [MSB block]; d1e49aac-8f56-4280-b9ba-993a6d77406c = Block process creations originating from PSExec and WMI commands [MSB audit]. Not in CIS or MSB, intentionally left unconfigured: 01443614-cd74-433a-b99e-2ecdc07bfc25 (executables unless prevalence/age/trusted list), c0033c00-d16d-4114-a5a0-dc9b3a7d2ceb (copied or impersonated system tools), 33ddedf1-c6e0-47cb-833e-de6133960387 (rebooting into Safe Mode), a8f5898e-1dc8-49a9-9878-85004b8a61e6 (webshell creation, servers). Caveats: needs Defender Antivirus as the active antivirus. The ransomware rule needs cloud protection. The WMI persistence rule can interfere with the Configuration Manager client, and the PsExec/WMI rule with management tools (hence audit). ASR-only exclusions (ExploitGuard_ASR_ASROnlyExclusions) are not managed here. CIS item numbers are v4.0.0 (v3.0.0: 18.10.42.6.1.1/.2; v5.0.1 table of contents: 18.10.42.6.1.2).

controls.title: SmartScreen za preuzete programe
controls.description: Prije pokretanja programa preuzetog s interneta Windows provjerava je li poznat i siguran. Nepoznati ili opasni programi se zaustavljaju.
controls.impact: Kod nepoznatog programa pojavi se upozorenje; uz 'Blokiraj' korisnik ga ne može zaobići pa takav program instalira IT.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno: upozori i spriječi zaobilaženje
Uključeno: upozori i spriječi zaobilaženje

controls.notes: WindowsExplorer.admx policy EnableSmartScreen (Windows Components > Windows Defender SmartScreen > Explorer > Configure Windows Defender SmartScreen) writes EnableSmartScreen = REG_DWORD 1 under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System. Its dropdown element ShellSmartScreenLevel = REG_SZ 'Block' (Warn and prevent bypass) or 'Warn'. EnableSmartScreen = 0 would turn SmartScreen off; we never write it. This setting is not in the Defender Antivirus section, so it stays in CIS Windows 11 v5.x. The reference shown is v4.0.0; v5.x numbering was not verified. Microsoft Edge SmartScreen and Enhanced Phishing Protection (WTDS) are separate settings.

controls.title: Temeljitije skeniranje
controls.description: Defender provjerava i e-poštu spremljenu na računalu te mape izuzete iz skeniranja, a pokreće brzo skeniranje ako se tjedan dana ništa nije skeniralo.
controls.impact: Ponekad se pokrene dodatno brzo skeniranje koje kratko uspori računalo.

benchmarks.recommendation: Provjera e-pošte uključena; Brzo skeniranje nakon 7 dana bez skeniranja; Izuzete mape i datoteke provjeravaju se kod brzog skeniranja; Provjera sažetih (pakiranih) programa uključena; Izračun sažetka (hash) datoteka uključen
Izuzete mape i datoteke provjeravaju se kod brzog skeniranja

controls.notes: Values under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender: Scan\DisableEmailScanning = 0 (Turn on e-mail scanning; mailbox files such as .pst/.mbx on disk). Scan\DaysUntilAggressiveCatchupQuickScan = 7 (CIS wants exactly 'Enabled: 7'). Scan\QuickScanIncludeExclusions = 1 (CIS L1 + MSB). Scan\DisablePackedExeScanning = 0 (Scan packed executables; WindowsDefender.admx Scan_DisablePackedExeScanning, enabledValue 0). MpEngine\EnableFileHashComputation = 1 (CIS L1; was in MSB 23H2, absent from MSB 24H2/25H2). 'Scan packed executables' is still CIS L1 (v3.0.0 18.10.42.13.1 per Wazuh; v4.0.0 18.10.43.13.2 per HardeningKitty; Fleet v5.0.1 L1). It is in the MSB 24H2 list but not in the MSB 25H2 list (Microsoft's stated reason, per the original research and not re-verified here: packed executables are always scanned, so the setting no longer has an effect); writing it is harmless and avoids a guaranteed CIS L1 failure on 'Preporučeno'. It is not an MSB item, so the MSB entry is unchanged. DisableEmailScanning, DisablePackedExeScanning and EnableFileHashComputation were checked in WindowsDefender.admx; the two newer Scan values against the CIS v4.0.0 and MSB 25H2 lists and Fleet v5.0.1.

controls.title: Skriveni popis iznimaka
controls.description: Popis mapa i datoteka koje antivirus preskače ne prikazuje se na računalu. Napadač tako ne može lako saznati gdje bi sakrio zlonamjerni program.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju; iznimke se ne vide u aplikaciji Sigurnost sustava Windows, ni lokalnim administratorima.

benchmarks.recommendation: Iznimke skrivene od lokalnih korisnika
Iznimke skrivene od lokalnih administratora

controls.notes: HideExclusionsFromLocalAdmins (WindowsDefender.admx, Enabled = 1) is the MSB setting, and it also hides exclusions from standard users. HideExclusionsFromLocalUsers = 1 (newer ADMX) is the CIS L1 item. Both are under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender. Exclusions set by policy stay readable in the GPO/Registry.pol. Local admins no longer see them in Windows Security or Get-MpPreference, so troubleshoot from the policy itself.

controls.title: Vatrozid uključen na svim mrežama
controls.description: Uključuje Windows vatrozid na svim vrstama mreža: u domeni, privatnoj i javnoj. Neželjene dolazne veze se blokiraju, a odlazni promet (internet, e-pošta) ostaje dopušten.
controls.impact: Obično se ništa ne mijenja. U strogoj opciji Windows više ne pita smije li neki program primati veze s mreže, a na javnim mrežama (hotel, kafić) zanemaruje iznimke koje su dodali programi, pa takvi programi tamo mogu prestati raditi.

benchmarks.recommendation: Vatrozid uključen na profilima domena, privatno i javno; Dolazne veze: blokiraj (zadano) na sva tri profila
Ne prikazuj obavijest kad je program blokiran; Na javnoj mreži ne primjenjuj lokalna pravila vatrozida ni lokalna pravila sigurnosti veze
Uključen na svim profilima, dolazno blokirano, odlazno dopušteno, bez obavijesti; na javnoj mreži zanemaruje lokalna pravila

controls.notes: Keys are the Windows Firewall with Advanced Security policy keys (PrivateProfile, not the legacy ADMX StandardProfile). They can be written through Registry.pol or Set-GPRegistryValue. 'strogo' adds DisableNotifications=1 on all profiles. On the Public profile it also adds AllowLocalPolicyMerge=0 and AllowLocalIPsecPolicyMerge=0: rules in the local store (added by app installers, netsh, the 'Allow an app' dialog, and also the built-in Windows rule groups such as Core Networking) are then ignored on public networks and only policy-delivered rules apply. When this is applied through LOCAL Group Policy (no policy rules are delivered), test apps that need inbound connections on public Wi-Fi and IPv6 connectivity on public networks. MSB values come from the 24H2 GPO report and the Intune 26H2 MDM baseline: inbound Block, outbound Allow, Disable Inbound Notifications=True, local rules No on Public. If a third-party firewall (AV suite) is registered in Windows Security Center, coordinate before enforcing. CIS v5 may no longer list 'Outbound connections: Allow'; DefaultOutboundAction=0 is still written so outbound traffic stays allowed.

controls.title: Zapisivanje prometa vatrozida
controls.description: Vatrozid zapisuje blokirane i dopuštene veze u datoteku, do 16 MB po vrsti mreže. Zapis pomaže kad treba istražiti napad ili problem s mrežom.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Na sva tri profila: ime datoteke zapisa postavljeno, veličina 16.384 KB ili više, bilježi odbačene pakete i uspješne veze
Veličina zapisa 16.384 KB, bilježi odbačene pakete i uspješne veze

controls.notes: matchMode atLeast is meant for LogFileSize: a larger log is fine, and CIS asks for 16,384 KB or greater. LogDroppedPackets and LogSuccessfulConnections are already at their maximum value (1). LogFilePath is a string: the state reader must compare it exactly or only check that it is present, never numerically. CIS v5.x only requires that a log name is configured (v3/v4 required these exact paths). MSB sets the size and both logging flags but no custom path. Microsoft recommends at least 20 MB (max 32,767 KB), so a larger size is acceptable. The default folder %SystemRoot%\System32\LogFiles\Firewall already carries the MpsSvc write ACL.

controls.title: Isključi zastarjeli SMB protokol
controls.description: SMB je protokol za dijeljene mape i pisače. Stara inačica SMBv1 ima poznate sigurnosne rupe (npr. WannaCry) i treba je isključiti. Strože opcije traže i noviju inačicu SMB 3.
controls.impact: Stariji NAS uređaji, skeneri koji spremaju dokumente u dijeljenu mapu i računala sa sustavom Windows 7 ili starijim možda se neće moći spojiti. Što je opcija stroža, to je više takvih uređaja.

benchmarks.recommendation: SMBv1 klijent isključen ('Configure SMB v1 client driver': Disable driver); SMBv1 poslužitelj isključen
Najniža dopuštena inačica SMB 3.1.1 (poslužitelj i klijent)
SMBv1 isključen; najniža inačica SMB 3.0.0 (od 24H2)

controls.notes: SMB1=0 (LanmanServer\Parameters) and mrxsmb10 Start=4 are the MS Security Guide values 'Configure SMB v1 server: Disabled' and 'Configure SMB v1 client driver: Enabled: Disable driver'. Both appear in the MSB 24H2 GPO report. Clean Windows 11 installs no longer include SMBv1, so on most PCs this only locks the state. The mrxsmb10 key may not exist: writing Start=4 creates a harmless stub key, and the state reader should treat a missing mrxsmb10 service as compliant. Do NOT write the pre-Win8.1 LanmanWorkstation DependOnService value. MinSmb2Dialect ('Mandate the minimum version of SMB', LanmanWorkstation/LanmanServer policy keys) is honoured only on Windows 11 24H2+ and Server 2025. 768 = 0x300 = SMB 3.0.0 (MSB); 785 = 0x311 = SMB 3.1.1 (CIS L1). Level 2 deliberately stays at 'smb1-off' (deviation from MSB): the server-side minimum blocks multifunction printers/scanners that scan to a shared folder on this PC over SMB 2.x, and the client-side minimum blocks SMB 2.x-only NAS devices; both are common in small offices and fail without a clear error. Choose 'smb3' explicitly once all scanners/NAS are known to speak SMB 3. 'smb311' (level 3) additionally blocks SMB 3.0/3.0.2-only devices (Windows 8.x/Server 2012 R2, many NAS/MFP firmwares). MinSmb2Dialect does not disable SMB1 by itself. matchMode is exact because SMB1/Start must match exactly; a PC with 785 is reported as 'smb311'.

controls.title: Obavezno potpisivanje SMB prometa
controls.description: Promet prema dijeljenim mapama digitalno se potpisuje, pa ga napadač u mreži ne može neprimjetno mijenjati ili preusmjeriti. Lozinke se nikad ne šalju nešifrirane.
controls.impact: Kopiranje s NAS-a može biti malo sporije. Vrlo stari NAS uređaji bez potpisivanja i mape bez lozinke prestat će raditi.

benchmarks.recommendation: Klijent uvijek potpisuje SMB promet; Ne šalji nešifriranu lozinku SMB poslužiteljima drugih proizvođača; Poslužitelj uvijek traži potpisani SMB promet
Potpisivanje uvijek obavezno za klijent i poslužitelj; nešifrirana lozinka zabranjena

controls.notes: These are the Security Options 'Microsoft network client/server: Digitally sign communications (always)' and 'Microsoft network client: Send unencrypted password to third-party SMB servers'. They can be written through Registry.pol and also exist in secedit [Registry Values]. Windows 11 24H2+ already requires SMB signing by default for inbound and outbound connections (Pro/Enterprise/Education); this locks the behaviour and applies it to older builds. Signing is incompatible with guest (passwordless) sessions, so expect old NAS devices with guest shares to fail. CIS v5 removed the '(if server agrees)' and '(if client agrees)' items, which only affect SMB1. Their removal shifted the numbering: 2.3.8.2 is now the plaintext-password item and 2.3.9.3 is 'Disconnect clients when logon hours expire'. EnableSecuritySignature is therefore not written.

controls.title: Zabrani gostujući pristup mapama
controls.description: Windows se neće spajati na dijeljene mape koje ne traže korisničko ime i lozinku. Takve veze napadač lako lažira i preko njih podmeće zlonamjerne datoteke.
controls.impact: Dijeljene mape bez lozinke na starim NAS uređajima prestat će raditi dok se na njima ne postave korisnički računi.

benchmarks.recommendation: 'Enable insecure guest logons' isključeno
Nesigurne gostujuće prijave isključene

controls.notes: Added control (not in the draft). This is the policy 'Network\Lanman Workstation\Enable insecure guest logons: Disabled'. It is already the default on Enterprise/Education since 1709 and on Pro since 24H2, so here it mainly locks the state on older Pro builds. It belongs with network.smb-signing, because guest sessions cannot be signed.

controls.title: Isključi LLMNR otkrivanje imena
controls.description: LLMNR je stari način traženja računala po imenu u lokalnoj mreži. Napadači ga koriste za krađu lozinki lažnim odgovorima. Imena računala u pravilu pronalazi DNS, pa LLMNR većini mreža nije potreban.
controls.impact: Korisnici obično ništa ne primjećuju; računala se i dalje pronalaze po imenu preko DNS-a i drugih načina u lokalnoj mreži.

benchmarks.recommendation: 'Turn off multicast name resolution' uključeno (LLMNR isključen)
LLMNR isključen

controls.notes: This is the policy 'Network\DNS Client\Turn off multicast name resolution: Enabled'. EnableMulticast=0 disables LLMNR; some forum posts claim the opposite value, which is wrong. 18.6.4.4 is the v4.0.0 position (v3.0.0 had it at 18.6.4.3; the 24H2 mDNS item was inserted before it). If a small office has no local DNS, names then resolve via NetBIOS (until network.netbios 'iskljuceno' is applied) and mDNS.

controls.title: Isključi NetBIOS otkrivanje imena
controls.description: NetBIOS je zastarjeli način pronalaženja računala slanjem upita cijeloj mreži. Isključivanje sprječava napade lažnim odgovorima i krađu lozinki.
controls.impact: Ako u mreži nema DNS poslužitelja, stari uređaji se možda neće pronaći po imenu (npr. \\NAS), nego samo po IP adresi.

benchmarks.recommendation: 'Configure NetBIOS settings': NetBIOS isključen barem na javnim mrežama
NetBT NodeType: P-node (bez emitiranja upita cijeloj mreži)
NodeType P-node i NetBIOS razrješavanje imena isključeno na svim mrežama (od 25H2)

controls.notes: EnableNetbios is the policy 'Network\DNS Client\Configure NetBIOS settings' (22H2+ ADMX). 0 = disable NetBIOS name resolution, 1 = allow, 2 = disable on public networks (the OS default, so 'javne' only locks it), 3 = learning mode. MSB 25H2+ sets 0. CIS L1 requires 'disable on public networks'; 0 is stricter and accepted. The CIS item number for 'Configure NetBIOS settings' is left out on purpose: the research gave 18.6.4.2 together with 18.6.4.1 for mDNS and 18.6.4.4 for LLMNR, which cannot all be true for the same benchmark version (the DNS Client section also holds the DoH item), and it could not be re-verified; fill it in from the CIS PDF. NodeType=2 (P-node) is the SecGuide setting 'NetBT NodeType configuration' and is in the MSB 24H2 report as Netbt\Parameters NodeType=2. It stops NetBIOS broadcasts, so without a WINS server NetBIOS name resolution fails; it needs a restart. Choosing 'javne' after 'iskljuceno' deletes NodeType (implied delete), which restores the Windows default node type. Neither value unbinds NetBIOS over TCP/IP from the adapters.

controls.title: Isključi mDNS otkrivanje imena
controls.description: mDNS traži uređaje u lokalnoj mreži bez DNS poslužitelja. Isključivanje smanjuje mogućnost lažnih odgovora, ali isključuje i automatsko pronalaženje uređaja.
controls.impact: Automatsko pronalaženje mrežnih pisača, Chromecasta i sličnih uređaja može prestati raditi. U mreži bez DNS poslužitelja računala i NAS uređaji tada se pronalaze samo po IP adresi.

benchmarks.recommendation: 'Configure multicast DNS (mDNS) protocol' isključeno

controls.notes: Added control (not in the draft). This is the policy 'Configure multicast DNS (mDNS) protocol' (Windows 11 24H2+ DnsClient.admx). It is in the CIS L1 audit files (v4.0.0 Enterprise, v5.0.0 Stand-alone) and not in the MS baseline. The CIS item number is left out on purpose: the research gave 18.6.4.1, which conflicts with its own 18.6.4.4 for LLMNR and with the DoH item that sorts first in the DNS Client section; fill it in from the CIS PDF. It sits at level 3 only for two reasons: Windows uses mDNS for printer and device discovery, and once LLMNR and NetBIOS are off (level 2) mDNS is the last fallback for local names in networks without local DNS. The policy value name EnableMDNS under the DNSClient policy key comes from PolicyPicker and Tenable; please re-check against DnsClient.admx. The non-policy equivalent is Dnscache\Parameters EnableMDNS, which is read at boot.

controls.title: Zabrani anonimno izlistavanje podataka
controls.description: Anonimni korisnici iz mreže ne mogu dobiti popis korisničkih računa i dijeljenih mapa ovog računala. Napadači takve popise koriste za pripremu napada.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Zabrani anonimno prevođenje SID/ime, anonimno izlistavanje računa i dijeljenih mapa, anonimni pristup cijevima i dijeljenjima; udaljeni SAM samo za administratore
Zabrana anonimnog izlistavanja računa i dijeljenih mapa, ograničen anonimni pristup cijevima i dijeljenjima, udaljeni SAM samo za administratore

controls.notes: Security Options covered: 'Do not allow anonymous enumeration of SAM accounts' (RestrictAnonymousSAM), '... of SAM accounts and shares' (RestrictAnonymous), 'Let Everyone permissions apply to anonymous users: Disabled', 'Restrict anonymous access to Named Pipes and Shares', 'Restrict clients allowed to make remote calls to SAM: Administrators: Remote Access: Allow' (SDDL O:BAG:BAD:(A;;RC;;;BA)) and 'Allow anonymous SID/Name translation: Disabled' (secedit LSAAnonymousNameLookup). Most are already Windows defaults; RestrictAnonymous=1 is the main real change. Only very old (NT4-era) browse or trust scenarios might break. EveryoneIncludesAnonymous and LSAAnonymousNameLookup are CIS-only. The v5.0.1 excerpt cut off the value for 2.3.10.5; 'Disabled' is assumed, as in all earlier versions.

controls.title: Samo sigurna NTLMv2 prijava
controls.description: Za mrežnu prijavu računalo koristi samo noviju inačicu NTLMv2 i odbija stare LM i NTLM prijave koje se lako razbijaju. Slabi LM sažeci lozinki se ne spremaju.
controls.impact: Vrlo stari uređaji, npr. skeneri koji spremaju dokumente u dijeljenu mapu ovog računala, mogu se prestati prijavljivati.

benchmarks.recommendation: LAN Manager razina provjere: šalji samo NTLMv2, odbij LM i NTLM; Najmanja NTLM SSP zaštita (klijent i poslužitelj): NTLMv2 sesija i 128-bitno šifriranje
Samo NTLMv2 (odbij LM i NTLM), bez spremanja LM sažetka, NTLMv2 sesija i 128-bitno šifriranje

controls.notes: LmCompatibilityLevel 5 = 'Send NTLMv2 response only. Refuse LM & NTLM'. In CIS v5.x it is 2.3.11.6; in v3/v4 it was 2.3.11.7. NTLMMinClientSec/NTLMMinServerSec 537395200 (0x20080000) = 'Require NTLMv2 session security, Require 128-bit encryption'. NoLMHash=1 is the OS default. CIS v5.x dropped 'Do not store LAN Manager hash value' (it was 2.3.11.5 in v4.0.0; that slot is now 'Force logoff when logon hours expire'), but MSB 24H2 and DISA STIG WN11-SO-000195 still require it. The NTLM SSP items were not visible in the MSB 24H2 report excerpt I could read. They have been part of every Windows baseline, but re-check them in the SCT 26H2 package. Kerberos is unaffected. The 'refuse' part only matters when this PC acts as the server (shares on the PC, scan-to-folder).

controls.title: Zaštićen pristup domenskim skriptama
controls.description: Kad je računalo u domeni, provjerava da skripte prijave i pravila grupe stvarno dolaze s domenskog kontrolera. Tako lažni poslužitelj ne može podmetnuti zlonamjerne postavke.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Hardened UNC Paths za NETLOGON i SYSVOL: međusobna provjera, integritet i privatnost (šifriranje)
Hardened UNC Paths za NETLOGON i SYSVOL: međusobna provjera i integritet

controls.notes: Added control (not in the draft). This is the policy 'Network\Network Provider\Hardened UNC Paths' (MS15-011). Value names are the literal UNC patterns \\*\NETLOGON and \\*\SYSVOL. It only has an effect on domain-joined PCs and is harmless in a workgroup. RequirePrivacy=1 needs SMB 3 encryption on the domain controllers (Server 2012+). CIS v5 requires privacy; MSB and DISA STIG require only mutual authentication and integrity. Windows 10+ already applies mutual auth and integrity to these paths by default, so 'potpis' mainly locks it.
controls.requirement: Djeluje samo na računalima u domeni.

controls.title: Zaštita od preusmjeravanja prometa
controls.description: Isključuje stare mrežne značajke (izvorno usmjeravanje i ICMP preusmjeravanje) kojima napadač može preusmjeriti promet. Računalo ignorira i lažne zahtjeve za oslobađanje NetBIOS imena.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Izvorno usmjeravanje potpuno isključeno (IPv4 i IPv6); ICMP preusmjeravanja isključena; Ignoriraj zahtjeve za oslobađanje NetBIOS imena osim od WINS poslužitelja
Izvorno usmjeravanje isključeno (IPv4/IPv6), ICMP preusmjeravanja isključena, NoNameReleaseOnDemand uključen

controls.notes: Added control (not in the draft). These are the MSS (Legacy) settings from MSS-legacy.admx in the Security Compliance Toolkit. DisableIPSourceRouting 2 = highest protection (source routing completely disabled). The values are read at TCP/IP and NetBT start, so a restart is needed. The CIS numbers (18.5.2/3/5/7) are the same in v3.0.0, v4.0.0 and v5.0.1. MSB presence was confirmed via the Intune 24H2 baseline and the MSCT Windows 11 audit; I could not see it in the GPO report excerpt.

controls.title: Udaljena radna površina (RDP)
controls.description: Određuje smije li se netko spojiti na ovo računalo preko Udaljene radne površine i uz koju zaštitu. Sigurne opcije traže provjeru korisnika prije spajanja i šifriranu vezu.
controls.impact: Ovisno o izboru: lozinka se upisuje pri svakom spajanju, lokalni diskovi se ne prenose u sesiju ili je spajanje na ovo računalo potpuno onemogućeno.

benchmarks.recommendation: Ne dopuštaj spremanje lozinki u klijentu Udaljene radne površine; Ne dopuštaj preusmjeravanje lokalnih diskova u sesiju; Uvijek traži lozinku pri spajanju
Obavezna sigurna RPC komunikacija; Sigurnosni sloj: SSL (TLS); Provjera korisnika prije spajanja (NLA); Razina šifriranja veze: visoka
Spajanje preko Udaljene radne površine onemogućeno
Bez spremanja lozinki, bez preusmjeravanja diskova, uvijek traži lozinku, sigurni RPC, visoka razina šifriranja

controls.notes: No option turns RDP on. 'osnovno' and 'sigurno' leave fDenyTSConnections untouched and only harden RDP if someone enables it. 'zabranjeno' sets fDenyTSConnections=1 (CIS L2) and keeps all hardening values, so the CIS L1 items still read as compliant at level 3. DisablePasswordSaving is a client-side (mstsc) setting. NLA (UserAuthentication) and SecurityLayer are CIS-only; MSB does not set them (they are effectively OS defaults). Windows 11 Home has no RDP host, and the policies are harmless there. 'zabranjeno' affects remote-management tools that rely on inbound RDP, but not TeamViewer, AnyDesk or Quick Assist. Not included: the CIS L2 items for idle-session limit (updated in v5.1.0), COM/LPT/PnP/location/WebAuthn redirection, and single session. The MS 26H2 baseline also enables Administrator protection (system category); its effect on RDP sign-in is unverified here and should be tested separately.

controls.title: Isključi Windows Udaljenu pomoć
controls.description: Isključuje staru Windows značajku Udaljena pomoć (Remote Assistance), i kad korisnik sam traži pomoć i kad je netko nudi. Prevaranti je koriste za lažnu 'tehničku podršku'.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju; Brza pomoć (Quick Assist), TeamViewer i AnyDesk i dalje rade.

benchmarks.recommendation: 'Configure Offer Remote Assistance' isključeno; 'Configure Solicited Remote Assistance' isključeno
Zatražena udaljena pomoć isključena

controls.notes: These are the policies 'System\Remote Assistance\Configure Offer Remote Assistance: Disabled' (fAllowUnsolicited=0) and 'Configure Solicited Remote Assistance: Disabled' (fAllowToGetHelp=0). MSB configures only Solicited; Offer is CIS-only and already disabled by default. CIS numbering moved from 18.9.35.x (v3/v4) to 18.9.37.x (v5.0.1). Quick Assist is a separate app and is not controlled by these policies.

controls.title: SmartScreen u Edgeu
controls.description: Edge upozorava na lažne (phishing) i zlonamjerne stranice, opasna preuzimanja i potencijalno neželjene programe. Uključena je i zaštita od lažnih adresa s tipfelerima.
controls.impact: Uz opciju Bez zaobilaženja korisnik ne može otvoriti stranicu ni preuzeti datoteku koju SmartScreen označi kao opasnu ili nepoznatu.

benchmarks.recommendation: Microsoft Edge security baseline v151: SmartScreen uključen i blokira potencijalno neželjene aplikacije.; Microsoft Edge security baseline v151: uključena zaštita od tipfelera u adresi (Website Typo Protection).
Microsoft Edge security baseline v151: zabrani zaobilaženje SmartScreen upozorenja za stranice i za preuzimanja.

controls.notes: The benchmark is the Microsoft Edge security baseline (MSB). The latest full baseline is v151; the HardeningKitty dev README groups v151 and v152 under one list, so v152 was a review without changes. The CIS Microsoft Edge Benchmark also recommends SmartScreen, PUA blocking and no-bypass. Its version and item numbers could not be checked here, so no CIS entry is listed; the CIS Windows 11 benchmark itself has no Edge section. All values are REG_DWORD 1 under HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Edge. Edge applies them after a browser restart; check edge://policy. PreventSmartScreenPromptOverrideForFiles blocks 'uncommon' downloads as well, not only malicious ones. File Explorer SmartScreen at the Windows level is a separate control (apps.windows-smartscreen).

controls.title: Sigurnosne postavke Edgea
controls.description: Primjenjuje Microsoftove preporučene sigurnosne postavke za Edge: jaču izolaciju stranica, bolju zaštitu spremljenih lozinki i kolačića te zabranu nastavka na stranice s neispravnim certifikatom.
controls.impact: Korisnik ne može zaobići upozorenje o neispravnom certifikatu ni koristiti osnovnu (Basic) prijavu, što može smetati na web sučelju rutera ili pisača; opcija Strogo blokira sva proširenja preglednika i isključuje već instalirana.

benchmarks.recommendation: Microsoft Edge security baseline v151: izolacija stranica i procesa, sandbox, zaštita podataka, bez zaobilaženja HTTPS upozorenja, samo NTLM/Negotiate prijava.
Microsoft Edge security baseline v151: blokiraj instalaciju svih proširenja ('*'); dopuštena proširenja dodaju se posebnim popisom.

controls.notes: ADDED beyond the draft list: every non-SmartScreen setting of the Edge v151 baseline. Five settings are new in v151 compared with v139: BrowserCodeIntegritySetting=2, EnhanceSecurityMode=1 ('Balanced'), NetworkServiceSandboxEnabled=1, ProcessIsolationEnabled=1 and RendererAppContainerEnabled=1. They come from the HardeningKitty dev-repo v151 list and could not be cross-checked on Microsoft Learn. BrowserCodeIntegritySetting and DynamicCodeSettings can break third-party software that injects DLLs into Edge, such as some AV, DLP or accessibility tools. AuthSchemes='ntlm,negotiate' removes Basic and Digest completely, even over HTTPS. That breaks many router, NAS and printer admin pages. NativeMessagingUserLevelHosts=0 can break desktop-app integration of extensions whose helper is installed per user, for example some password managers. ExtensionInstallBlocklist '*' (key ...\Edge\ExtensionInstallBlocklist, value name '1') also disables extensions that are already installed, such as password managers. They are disabled, not uninstalled, and come back when the blocklist entry is removed; force-installed extensions (ExtensionInstallForcelist) are exempt. The baseline expects an ExtensionInstallAllowlist for approved extensions; GPO Studio does not offer one yet. The sandbox and process settings (SitePerProcess, RendererAppContainerEnabled, NetworkServiceSandboxEnabled, BrowserCodeIntegritySetting, DynamicCodeSettings, ApplicationBoundEncryptionEnabled, ProcessIsolationEnabled) take effect only after Edge is fully closed and reopened, not on a policy refresh. No Windows restart is needed. Edge ignores some policies on unmanaged devices (not domain-joined, not MDM). None of these settings is known to be in that group, but check edge://policy.

controls.title: Makronaredbe u Officeu
controls.description: Makronaredbe u Wordu, Excelu i drugim Office datotekama čest su način širenja zlonamjernog softvera. Postavka blokira makronaredbe u datotekama s interneta i iz e-pošte, a strože opcije ograničavaju i ostale.
controls.impact: Makronaredbe u preuzetim datotekama neće se pokretati; uz opciju Samo potpisane ne rade ni nepotpisane makronaredbe u vlastitim datotekama, osim u pouzdanim lokacijama.

benchmarks.recommendation: Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise security baseline v2512: blokiraj makronaredbe u datotekama s interneta (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Visio, Project, Publisher).
Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise security baseline v2512: Excel ne smije pokretati stare XLM (Excel 4.0) makronaredbe.

Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise security baseline v2512: onemogući sve makronaredbe osim digitalno potpisanih; potpis mora biti od pouzdanog izdavača.; Microsoft 365 Apps for enterprise security baseline v2512: antivirusna (AMSI) provjera makronaredbi za sve dokumente.

controls.notes: These are user-scope policies under HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Office\16.0\<app>\security. 16.0 covers Office 2016/2019/2021/2024 and Microsoft 365 Apps. In local GP, the User Registry.pol applies to every user, including administrators. For a domain GPO, link it to OUs that contain the users (or use loopback). VBAWarnings is a REG_DWORD: 1 = enable all, 2 = disable all with notification (Office default), 3 = disable all except digitally signed, 4 = disable all without notification. atLeast works for VBAWarnings, because 3 and 4 also satisfy 2. vbadigsigtrustedpublishers=1 only matters when VBAWarnings=3. The baseline sets it for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Visio and Publisher, but not Project. The baseline also writes vbarequirelmtrustedpublisher=0 and vbarequiredigsigwithcodesigningeku=0 (checkbox defaults); these are left out. Outlook macros (outlook\security\level=3 in the baseline) are not covered. Office has blocked internet macros by default since 2022 (Current Channel 2203). The policy enforces this so users cannot enable such macros from the trust bar. Removing the Mark of the Web via file Properties > Unblock still works; see apps.attachment-zone. Level 2 ('notify') deliberately does not meet the MSB VBA requirement, because unsigned business macros are common in small offices. The CIS Microsoft 365 Apps benchmark has similar items but was not used, because it could not be verified here.

controls.title: Microsoft Store
controls.description: Određuje smiju li korisnici sami instalirati aplikacije iz Microsoft Storea. Automatsko ažuriranje aplikacija ostaje uključeno, a Windows ne nudi nadogradnju sustava preko Storea.
controls.impact: Uz opciju Isključen korisnici ne mogu otvoriti Store (samo Windows Enterprise i Education), a ugrađene aplikacije možda se više neće same ažurirati.

benchmarks.recommendation: Automatsko preuzimanje i instalacija ažuriranja aplikacija ostaje uključeno (politika 'Turn off Automatic Download and Install of updates' = Disabled).; Isključi ponudu nadogradnje na najnoviju verziju Windowsa (Omogućeno).
Isključi aplikaciju Store (Omogućeno).; Isključi pristup Storeu pri otvaranju nepoznatih vrsta datoteka (Omogućeno).

controls.notes: Only Windows Enterprise and Education honor RemoveWindowsStore; Pro ignores it. On Pro, option 'off' only adds NoUseStoreOpenWith. NoUseStoreOpenWith, AutoDownload and DisableOSUpgrade work on all editions. AutoDownload=4 is the CIS 'Disabled' state of 'Turn off Automatic Download and Install of updates', which keeps app auto-update on; 2 would turn it off. UPDATE RISK of 'off': the ADMX help text of 'Turn off the Store application' says access to the Store is required for installing app updates. Microsoft Learn ('Configure access to Microsoft Store') also warns that enabling it turns off app updates from Microsoft Store. Both were recalled from memory and not re-fetched in this session; confirm on a pilot machine. So 'off' can stop updates of inbox and Store apps on Enterprise/Education: App Installer/winget, image and video codecs, Notepad, Paint, Snipping Tool. That is a security cost. Use level 3 'off' only where app updates come from another channel (Intune/MDM, or winget running as SYSTEM); otherwise choose 'allowed'. Not used: CIS 18.10.66.1 (L2) 'Disable all apps from Microsoft Store' (DisableStoreApps=1 per CIS audit data). Its semantics are counter-intuitive and it needs testing before it is offered. CIS v3.0.0 also had 'Only display the private store' (RequirePrivateStoreOnly); v4.0.0 removed it. MSB does not configure the Store.
controls.requirement: Isključivanje Trgovine djeluje samo na Windows Enterprise i Education; ostale postavke na svim izdanjima.

controls.title: Windows Script Host (VBS/JS)
controls.description: Windows Script Host pokreće .vbs i .js skripte, koje napadači često šalju u privicima e-pošte. Isključivanjem se takve skripte ne mogu pokrenuti dvoklikom.
controls.impact: Ne rade .vbs i .js skripte, uključujući stare skripte za prijavu na domenu, neke instalacijske programe i alat slmgr za aktivaciju Windowsa.
controls.notes: Not part of CIS Windows 11 or the Microsoft baselines. The key is NOT under Policies, so writing it through Registry.pol tattoos the value: removing the setting from the GPO does not restore it. That is why there is an explicit 'on' option (action Delete) to undo it. 32-bit host: every Windows 11 is 64-bit (x64 or ARM64) and also ships a 32-bit WSH in %SystemRoot%\SysWOW64 (wscript.exe, cscript.exe). A 32-bit process reading HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows Script Host\Settings is redirected to HKLM\Software\WOW6432Node\..., because this key is not on the WOW64 shared-key list. With only the 64-bit value, double-click (which uses System32\wscript.exe) is blocked, but a shortcut, HTA or script that calls SysWOW64\wscript.exe still runs. Both views are therefore set by 'off' and deleted by 'on'. The registry CSE runs as a 64-bit process and writes the literal WOW6432Node path. Confirm on a pilot machine that SysWOW64\wscript.exe reports 'Windows Script Host access is disabled'. Type: common hardening scripts use REG_DWORD 0. WSH's own values in this key (DisplayLogo, UseWINSAFER) are REG_SZ, and REG_SZ "0" is also widely reported to work. Test on a pilot machine. A per-user value under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows Script Host\Settings may override it unless IgnoreUserSettings is set in HKLM. This was not verified and is not added. Breaks: .vbs/.js/.wsf logon scripts, slmgr.vbs and ospp.vbs (activation), some vendor installers and printer scripts such as prnport.vbs. Does not block VBScript inside Office or mshta. Microsoft is deprecating VBScript (Feature on Demand, planned to be disabled by default), so this setting will break less over time.

controls.title: Instalacija naredbom (winget)
controls.description: Zatvara rizične opcije alata App Installer i winget, npr. zaobilaženje provjere datoteka i instalaciju preko web poveznica. Opcija Isključeno potpuno gasi winget i App Installer.
controls.impact: Uz opciju Sigurno korisnici ništa ne primjećuju; uz opciju Isključeno ne rade winget i instalacija .appx/.msix paketa dvoklikom.

benchmarks.recommendation: Isključene eksperimentalne značajke, zaobilaženje provjere hash vrijednosti i skeniranja arhiva, zaobilaženje provjere certifikata Storea i protokol ms-appinstaller.
Isključen App Installer (Onemogućeno).; Isključeno sučelje naredbenog retka Windows Package Managera (winget).

controls.notes: ADDED beyond the draft list. Values come from CIS v4.0.0 items 18.10.18.x; v3.0.0 had only 18.10.17.1-18.10.17.4. Not in MSB. Level 3 deliberately stays on 'safe': disabling winget breaks winget-based patching ('winget upgrade --all'), which is often the only way small offices update third-party apps. The App Installer ADMX (DesktopAppInstaller.admx) is needed only to edit these in gpedit; the registry values work without it.

controls.title: Oznaka preuzetih datoteka
controls.description: Windows pamti da je datoteka stigla s interneta ili iz e-pošte i pri otvaranju je daje antivirusnom programu na provjeru. Na toj oznaci rade i SmartScreen i blokiranje makronaredbi.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Čuvaj podatak o podrijetlu (zoni) u privicima: politika 'Do not preserve zone information' = Onemogućeno.; Obavijesti antivirusni program pri otvaranju privitaka (Omogućeno).

controls.notes: ADDED beyond the draft list, because Office internet-macro blocking and SmartScreen both rely on it (Mark of the Web). User scope, under a policy key, so no tattooing. SaveZoneInformation 2 = keep zone information (1 would turn it off). ScanWithAntiVirus 3 = always scan. Not in MSB. The item numbers are the same in CIS v3.0.0 and v4.0.0.

controls.title: Dijagnostički podaci Microsoftu
controls.description: Određuje koliko podataka o radu računala Windows šalje Microsoftu. Manje podataka znači bolju privatnost.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Isključeno ili samo obavezni dijagnostički podaci

controls.notes: GP 'Allow Diagnostic Data'. Windows 11 values: 0 = diagnostic data off, 1 = Required, 3 = Optional (2/Enhanced is retired on Windows 11). Only Enterprise, Education, IoT Enterprise and Server honour 0; Pro/Home silently treat it as 1, so show an edition hint when 'Isključeno' is picked on Pro. With 0, Windows Update for Business reports, Autopatch, Intune Endpoint analytics and similar Microsoft reporting lose data; Windows Update itself keeps working. CIS L1 accepts 0 or 1 (audit operator <= 1). Not in MSB.
controls.requirement: Opcija 'Isključeno' djeluje samo na Enterprise i Education; Pro tada šalje samo obavezne podatke.

controls.title: Bez anketa i dodatnih zapisa
controls.description: Windows više ne traži od korisnika ocjene i povratne informacije. Microsoftu šalje i manje dodatnih podataka o greškama i rušenjima programa.
controls.impact: Korisnici više ne vide skočne ankete za povratne informacije.

benchmarks.recommendation: Ne prikazivati obavijesti za povratne informacije; Ograničiti prikupljanje dijagnostičkih zapisa; Ograničiti prikupljanje podataka o rušenju (memory dump); Isključiti preuzimanje postavki s usluge OneSettings; Bilježiti upite prema usluzi OneSettings

controls.notes: Five CIS L1 'Data Collection and Preview Builds' items merged into one switch. All values are DWORD 1 under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection (DataCollection.admx; DoNotShowFeedbackNotifications comes from FeedbackNotifications.admx but uses the same key). DisableOneSettingsDownloads stops Windows downloading diagnostic configuration from Microsoft's OneSettings service. If a Microsoft diagnostics or reporting feature misbehaves, check this value first. The description was reworded because 'ispis memorije' (memory dump) is jargon for office users. Not in MSB. Works independently of the AllowTelemetry level chosen in privacy.telemetry.

controls.title: Bez praćenja za oglase
controls.description: Isključuje oglasni ID i prilagođene preporuke na temelju dijagnostičkih podataka. Aplikacije tada ne mogu pratiti korisnika radi oglasa.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju; oglasi u aplikacijama su manje osobni.

benchmarks.recommendation: Oglasni ID isključen; Ne koristiti dijagnostičke podatke za prilagođena iskustva

controls.notes: Machine GP 'Turn off the advertising ID' (User Profiles) plus User GP 'Do not use diagnostic data for tailored experiences' (Cloud Content). Both are CIS Level 2 only, but users see no difference, so they are on from level 1. Not in MSB. The User value goes into the user part of Registry.pol / the GPO user configuration and applies to every user of the PC.

controls.title: Bez reklama i preporuka
controls.description: Windows ne instalira sam preporučene aplikacije i igre. Ne prikazuje ni reklamne obavijesti ni prijedloge aplikacija drugih tvrtki.
controls.impact: U izborniku Start i postavkama više nema preporučenih aplikacija i reklamnih poruka.

benchmarks.recommendation: Microsoftova potrošačka iskustva isključena; Isključen sadržaj o stanju potrošačkog računa iz oblaka; Bez prijedloga sadržaja drugih tvrtki u Windows Spotlightu
Isključen sadržaj optimiziran iz oblaka
Microsoftova potrošačka iskustva isključena; Bez prijedloga sadržaja drugih tvrtki u Windows Spotlightu

controls.notes: Cloud Content policies (CloudContent.admx). Only Enterprise and Education honour DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures ('Turn off Microsoft consumer experiences'); Pro has ignored it since 1607. DisableThirdPartySuggestions is a User policy. In this area MSB 25H2 (HardeningKitty GPO list) contains only the consumer-experiences and third-party-suggestions settings. The '26H2' evidence is a community Intune export (dgulle/Security-Baselines, JSON createdDateTime 2025-02-17), not a Microsoft download, so treat it as corroboration only. The Spotlight lock-screen and desktop items are in privacy.spotlight. Gap for maintainers: CIS L1 18.10.72.1 'Allow widgets' = Disabled (Machine, Software\Policies\Microsoft\Dsh, AllowNewsAndInterests=0) is not covered by any control in the catalog. It removes the Widgets board (news and ads feed), so it should be a separate, visible control rather than hidden in this switch.
controls.requirement: Puni učinak na Windows 11 Enterprise i Education; Pro poštuje samo prijedloge trećih strana.

controls.title: Windows Spotlight slike i savjeti
controls.description: Isključuje Spotlight, tj. dnevne slike s interneta, savjete i promotivni sadržaj na zaključanom zaslonu i radnoj površini.
controls.impact: Zaključani zaslon i pozadina prikazuju običnu sliku umjesto dnevne slike s interneta.

benchmarks.recommendation: Spotlight na zaključanom zaslonu isključen (Disabled); Spotlight zbirka na radnoj površini isključena
Sve Spotlight značajke isključene
