controls.notes: User-scope Cloud Content policies. 'Configure Windows spotlight on lock screen' = Disabled writes ConfigureWindowsSpotlight=2 (1 would force Spotlight on). Microsoft documents the Spotlight background policies for Enterprise/Education; Pro may ignore them. Level 1 leaves Spotlight alone because it only changes the look and has no security effect. Not in MSB (MSB only sets DisableThirdPartySuggestions; see privacy.consumer-experiences).
controls.requirement: Puni učinak na Windows 11 Enterprise i Education.

controls.title: Privatnost zaključanog zaslona
controls.description: Dok je računalo zaključano, nije moguće koristiti kameru, glasovne naredbe ni prezentaciju slika. Strogi način skriva i obavijesti, da se ne vidi njihov sadržaj.
controls.impact: Kamera i glasovni pomoćnik ne rade na zaključanom zaslonu; obavijesti se vide tek nakon otključavanja.

benchmarks.recommendation: Zabranjena kamera na zaključanom zaslonu; Zabranjena prezentacija slika na zaključanom zaslonu; Aplikacije se ne smiju aktivirati glasom dok je sustav zaključan; Cortana nije dostupna na zaključanom zaslonu
Bez obavijesti aplikacija na zaključanom zaslonu (za cijelo računalo); Bez skočnih obavijesti na zaključanom zaslonu
Zabranjena kamera na zaključanom zaslonu; Zabranjena prezentacija slika na zaključanom zaslonu; Aplikacije se ne smiju aktivirati glasom dok je sustav zaključan
Bez skočnih obavijesti na zaključanom zaslonu

controls.notes: LetAppsActivateWithVoiceAboveLock=2 means 'Force Deny' (AppPrivacy.admx enum 0/1/2). NoToastApplicationNotificationOnLockScreen is a User policy (WPN.admx, Start Menu and Taskbar > Notifications). Added to 'strict': the machine policy 'System > Logon > Turn off app notifications on the lock screen' (Logon.admx, Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System, DisableLockScreenAppNotifications=1). It is CIS L1 18.9.28.5 in v4.0.0 (HardeningKitty) and v3.0.0 (Wazuh). No other control in the catalog covered it (it was only mentioned in these notes), so the CIS L1 comparison had a gap. As a machine policy it also covers users who sign in for the first time. Not in MSB. AllowCortanaAboveLock sits here rather than in privacy.search because it is about what the lock screen exposes.

controls.title: Isključi lokaciju
controls.description: Windows i aplikacije ne mogu doznati gdje se računalo nalazi. Lokacija se ne šalje ni Microsoftu ni aplikacijama.
controls.impact: Karte, vremenska prognoza, automatska vremenska zona i 'Pronađi moj uređaj' neće raditi.

benchmarks.recommendation: Lokacija isključena

controls.notes: GP 'Location and Sensors > Turn off location'. CIS Level 2 only and not in MSB, so it is on only at level 3. CIS L2 also sets the Geolocation Service (lfsvc) to Disabled (v4.0.0 item 5.6). That is a service start type (secedit [Service General Setting] / System Services), not a Registry.pol value, so it is not written here. Laptops that travel between time zones lose automatic time-zone detection.

controls.title: Pretraživanje bez Cortane
controls.description: Isključuje Cortanu i zabranjuje pretraživanju da koristi lokaciju računala. Strogi način isključuje i rezultate iz oblaka i istaknute teme u pretraživanju.
controls.impact: Pretraživanje datoteka i aplikacija na računalu radi kao i prije; u strogom načinu u Windows pretraživanju nema dokumenata iz OneDrivea, SharePointa i Outlooka.

benchmarks.recommendation: Cortana isključena; Pretraživanje i Cortana ne smiju koristiti lokaciju
Pretraživanje u oblaku isključeno; Istaknuto u pretraživanju (search highlights) isključeno

controls.notes: Windows Search policies under Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search (Search.admx; AllowCloudSearch is an enum 0/1/2, the others are 1/0 flags). Current Windows 11 builds no longer ship the Cortana app; CIS still audits AllowCortana and setting it does no harm. 'Samo lokalno' (AllowCloudSearch=0) removes OneDrive, SharePoint and Outlook (Microsoft 365 account) results from Windows Search. The impact text now says so, because the previous text ('radi kao i prije') was only true for 'Bez Cortane'. Search policy changes may need a sign-out before they show. In this area MSB only sets AllowIndexingEncryptedStoresOrItems=0, which is a security setting and not part of this group.

controls.title: Povijest aktivnosti
controls.description: Windows ne šalje Microsoftu popis aplikacija, datoteka i stranica koje korisnik otvara. Strogi način potpuno isključuje vođenje te povijesti.
controls.impact: Korisnici uglavnom ništa ne primjećuju; nastavak rada na drugom uređaju neće raditi.

benchmarks.recommendation: Zabranjeno slanje korisničkih aktivnosti

controls.notes: OS Policies: 'Enables Activity Feed' (EnableActivityFeed), 'Allow publishing of User Activities' (PublishUserActivities), 'Allow upload of User Activities' (UploadUserActivities); 0 = Disabled. CIS audits only UploadUserActivities (Level 2). Windows 11 no longer has Timeline, so the real-world impact is small. Not in MSB.

controls.title: Recall snimke zaslona
controls.description: Recall na novim Copilot+ računalima stalno snima zaslon da bi se sadržaj kasnije mogao pretraživati. Ova postavka sprječava spremanje snimki ili potpuno uklanja Recall.
controls.impact: Recall se ne može koristiti; na računalima bez Recalla nema nikakve promjene.
controls.notes: Windows AI policies (WindowsCopilot.admx), key Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI. 'Turn off saving snapshots for use with Recall' (DisableAIDataAnalysis=1) exists under both Computer and User configuration, so both scopes are written. Turning it on deletes snapshots that are already saved. 'Allow Recall to be enabled' (AllowRecallEnablement=0, machine only) needs Windows 11 24H2 with KB5055627 (build 26100.3915) or later. It removes the Recall optional component and deletes snapshots. It needs a restart, and bringing Recall back later means restoring the component, so the UI should warn. Only Copilot+ PCs have Recall. On managed (domain/MDM) devices it is off by default, but on small-office workgroup PCs the user may have opted in during setup, so level 1 already blocks snapshots. Benchmarks: not in CIS Windows 11 Enterprise v4.0.0 (absent from the v4 list) and not in MSB 25H2/26H2. CIS Microsoft Windows 11 Stand-alone Benchmark v5.0.0 has 18.10.73.1 (L1) 'Allow Recall to be enabled' = Disabled (per Tenable). CIS Enterprise v5.x very likely has a matching L1 item, which option 'removed' would satisfy. Add a CIS-L1 entry once its v5.x number is confirmed.
controls.requirement: Copilot+ računala s Windows 11 24H2 ili novijim; na ostalima nema učinka.

controls.title: Bez prepoznavanja govora u oblaku
controls.description: Isključuje Microsoftovo mrežno prepoznavanje govora. Glasovni zapisi korisnika ne šalju se u oblak.
controls.impact: Glasovno diktiranje i glasovne naredbe koje trebaju internet neće raditi.

benchmarks.recommendation: Korisnici ne smiju uključiti mrežno prepoznavanje govora

controls.notes: GP 'Control Panel > Regional and Language Options > Allow users to enable online speech recognition services' = Disabled (AllowInputPersonalization=0). Features that run on the device, such as Voice access, keep working. Not in MSB. Left out of level 1 because people who use voice typing would notice.

controls.title: Kontrola korisničkog računa (UAC)
controls.description: UAC traži potvrdu prije nego što program dobije administratorske ovlasti. Tako zlonamjerni program ne može neprimjetno mijenjati sustav.
controls.impact: Uz Preporučeno i Strogo standardni korisnici više ne dobivaju prozor za upis administratorske lozinke, pa programe instalira administrator prijavljen svojim računom; administratori, i ugrađeni račun Administrator, potvrđuju svaku promjenu sustava, a uz Strogo upisuju lozinku.

benchmarks.recommendation: UAC uključen; administratori potvrđuju na sigurnoj radnoj površini (pristanak ili lozinka); zahtjevi standardnih korisnika automatski se odbijaju; ugrađeni Administrator također traži potvrdu
UAC uključen; administratori: pristanak na sigurnoj radnoj površini; standardni korisnici: automatsko odbijanje; ugrađeni Administrator traži potvrdu

controls.notes: All values are Security Options under HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System; writing them through Registry.pol works but tattoos (they stay after the GPO is removed). ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin: 0 elevate without prompt, 1 credentials on secure desktop, 2 consent on secure desktop, 3 credentials, 4 consent, 5 consent for non-Windows binaries (default). ConsentPromptBehaviorUser: 0 auto-deny, 1 credentials on secure desktop, 3 credentials (default). 'standard' = Windows defaults with UAC forced on (repairs a disabled UAC). A restart is only needed when EnableLUA or FilterAdministratorToken actually changes; prompt behaviour applies immediately. With auto-deny, standard users get 'access denied' instead of a password prompt; IT must sign in with an admin account to install software. 'strict' (admin value 1) satisfies CIS ('consent on the secure desktop or higher'; AuditTAP CIS 4.0.0 accepts 1 or 2) and is stricter than MSB's literal 2 - counted as satisfying MSB, but literal-diff tools will flag it. PromptOnSecureDesktop is a CIS item only (MSB leaves the default). CIS v5.0.1 section 2.3.17 numbering is unchanged from v4.0.0 (2.3.17.1-2.3.17.4, 2.3.17.6, 2.3.17.7 confirmed for v5.0.1), which also indicates CIS has not added the Administrator protection settings.

controls.title: Zaštita administratora
controls.description: Novija zaštita u Windowsima 11: administrator radi s običnim ovlastima, a za svaku administratorsku radnju dobiva privremeno, odvojeno ovlaštenje uz potvrdu lozinkom ili Windows Hellom.
controls.impact: Administratori svaku instalaciju ili promjenu sustava potvrđuju lozinkom, PIN-om ili licem; neki stariji alati mogu prestati raditi.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključena zaštita administratora; potvrda lozinkom na sigurnoj radnoj površini

controls.notes: Windows 11 24H2+ client only (not Server, Windows 365, AVD). Microsoft updated the 26H2 baseline (v2 package) for Administrator protection GA with 'Configure type of Admin Approval Mode' = Admin Approval Mode with Administrator protection (TypeOfAdminApprovalMode=2) and the Administrator-protection prompt = 'Prompt for credentials on the secure desktop'; MC1506291: for baseline users it becomes enabled by default with the October 2026 security update (24H2/25H2/26H2). ConsentPromptBehaviorEnhancedAdmin=1 is used for 'credentials': issue #217 (0x6d69636b/windows_hardening) quotes the Policy CSP LocalPoliciesSecurityOptions page as '1 -> Prompt for credentials on secure desktop' (default) and calls HardeningKitty's 2 wrong. AuditTAP's MSB 25H2 check also expects 1 but LABELS it 'Prompt for consent on the secure desktop' (old 'Enhanced Privilege Protection Mode' wording), so it confirms the value, not its meaning. The dgulle 26H2 Intune export has no Administrator protection settings. Verify on a test device. Not in CIS v5.0.1. Known issues: Group Policy refresh failures with the baseline on Aug/Sept 2026 previews (reported fixed by KB5127648), conflicts with Endpoint Privilege Management tools, no auto-elevation for Windows binaries, Project Zero bypasses (reported fixed). 'legacy' (1) is Microsoft's documented rollback; it is not tied to any level. Restart required.
controls.requirement: Windows 11 24H2 ili noviji, samo klijentska računala.

controls.title: UAC za mrežne prijave
controls.description: Lokalni administratorski račun koji se prijavljuje preko mreže ne dobiva automatski pune ovlasti. Napadaču je tako teže s jednog zaraženog računala preuzeti ostala.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju; neki alati za udaljeno upravljanje koji koriste lokalni administratorski račun mogu trebati domenski račun.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno (UAC ograničenja za lokalne račune pri mrežnoj prijavi)
Uključeno

controls.notes: MS Security Guide (SecGuide.admx) 'Apply UAC restrictions to local accounts on network logons': Enabled = LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy 0, which is also the Windows default. Breaks remote administration with LOCAL admin accounts (PsExec, admin shares like C$, some RMM/backup agents); domain accounts are not affected.

controls.title: Instalacije bez skrivenih ovlasti
controls.description: Windows Installer (.msi) ne smije svaku instalaciju automatski pokretati s administratorskim ovlastima, a korisnici ne mogu mijenjati sigurnosne opcije instalacije. Inače bi svatko preko .msi paketa mogao preuzeti računalo.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: Isključeno 'Uvijek instaliraj s povišenim ovlastima' (računalo i korisnik) i 'Dopusti korisniku kontrolu nad instalacijama'
Isključeno 'Uvijek instaliraj s povišenim ovlastima' i 'Dopusti korisniku kontrolu nad instalacijama' (računalo)

controls.notes: AlwaysInstallElevated only takes effect when it is 1 in BOTH HKLM and HKCU; forcing 0 in both blocks this classic privilege escalation. In CIS v4.0.0 these are 18.10.81.1 (EnableUserControl), 18.10.81.2 (computer) and 19.7.44.1 (user); the v5.x numbers were not verified (section 18.10 was renumbered), so no reference is given. MSB does not configure the user-scope value. Defaults are already 'not elevated'.

controls.title: Zaštita lozinki u memoriji (LSA)
controls.description: Windows proces koji čuva prijave i lozinke (LSASS) radi kao zaštićeni proces. Alati za krađu lozinki tako ne mogu čitati njegovu memoriju.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju, ali vrlo stari dodaci za prijavu mogu se prestati učitavati, a 'Trajno uključeno' ne može se poništiti samo promjenom postavke.

benchmarks.recommendation: Uključeno s UEFI zaključavanjem
Uključeno s UEFI zaključavanjem

controls.notes: RunAsPPL: 0 off, 1 on with UEFI lock, 2 on without UEFI lock (Win11 22H2+). The CIS benchmark text (quoted in Fleet's CIS policy set) says the 23H2 ADMX wrote HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa:RunAsPPL and the 24H2+ ADMX writes HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System:RunAsPPL. Written to BOTH locations: the classic Lsa path (honoured by every build; HardeningKitty's MSB 25H2 list still checks only this path) and the 24H2+ policy path (AuditTAP's MSB 25H2 check reads this one). With the UEFI lock the state lives in a UEFI variable: deleting the registry values does NOT turn it off; Microsoft's LSA Protected Process Opt-out tool (LSAPPLConfig.efi) at the console is needed. Level 2 deliberately uses 2 (reversible) and therefore does not meet CIS/MSB literally; level 3 matches both. After reboot, System log event 12 (Wininit) confirms protected mode; blocked plug-ins are logged in Microsoft-Windows-CodeIntegrity/Operational. CIS number was 18.9.26.2 in v4.0.0, 18.9.27.2 in v5.0.1.

controls.title: Isključen WDigest
controls.description: Sprječava da Windows za staru WDigest prijavu drži lozinke u memoriji u čitljivom obliku. Napadač tako ne može jednostavno pročitati lozinke prijavljenih korisnika.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: WDigest prijava isključena

controls.notes: Removed from MSB in the 25H2 baseline (deprecated; WDigest credential caching disabled by default since Windows 8.1) and absent from 26H2; still CIS v5.0.1 L1 (18.4.7) and DISA STIG. Explicit 0 guards against attackers/tools setting 1. Applies to new logons (no restart; credentials already cached stay until sign-out). Stale values from older baselines are harmless.

controls.title: Zaštita od zlouporabe grešaka (SEHOP)
controls.description: Uključuje ugrađenu Windows zaštitu koja blokira čestu tehniku napada preko grešaka u programima.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju.

benchmarks.recommendation: SEHOP uključen
SEHOP uključen

controls.notes: MS Security Guide setting: DisableExceptionChainValidation 0 = SEHOP enabled (kernel reads it at boot). Added beyond the draft list because it is in both standards with no user impact; very old 32-bit apps can be exempted per-app via Exploit protection. Deduplicate by id if an exploit-protection category elsewhere emits it.

controls.title: Revizija sigurnosnih događaja
controls.description: Windows bilježi prijave i odjave, neuspjele pokušaje prijave, zaključavanja računa te promjene korisnika i grupa. Ti zapisi pomažu otkriti napad i kasnije utvrditi što se dogodilo.
controls.impact: Korisnici ništa ne primjećuju; zapisnik Sigurnost brže raste.

benchmarks.recommendation: Napredne potkategorije revizije imaju prednost pred starim kategorijama (Omogućeno).
Svih 27 potkategorija napredne revizije s CIS vrijednostima (prijave, računi, promjene pravila, privilegije, sustav).
Napredne potkategorije revizije imaju prednost pred starim kategorijama (Omogućeno).
Microsoftova preporuka: 23 vrste sigurnosnih zapisa (uži popis od CIS-ovog). Korištenje posebnih ovlasti bilježi samo uspješne pokušaje.

controls.notes: Audit values follow CIS v4.0.0 section 17; every item there is Level 1. CIS words some items as 'include Success' or 'include Failure'. So for audit, matchMode 'atLeast' should mean: the actual flags must be a SUPERSET of ours (Success,Failure satisfies Success). Option 'basic' is the logon/lockout/account-management core: 8 subcategories with CIS values. On its own it satisfies neither CIS nor MSB. Option 'extended' covers all 27 CIS L1 subcategories. It is a superset of the MSB Windows 11 25H2/26H2 audit set, so it satisfies MSB under superset semantics. Where MSB differs from CIS: since 23H2, MSB sets Sensitive Privilege Use to Success only (CIS wants Success,Failure; the 22H2 MSB still had Success,Failure). Tools that compare exactly (Policy Analyzer; HardeningKitty's MSB 25H2 list checks this item with '=') will report 'extended' as a deviation from MSB on that one subcategory, although it logs more. Failure auditing there (event 4673) is noisy on Windows 11, which is the likely reason MSB dropped it. MSB does not configure Logoff, Application Group Management, Authorization Policy Change or IPsec Driver. Subcategory names are the English auditpol names; CIS calls 'Plug and Play Events' 'Audit PNP Activity'. On localized systems (for example Croatian Windows) the names differ, so use the GUIDs: auditpol /set /subcategory:{GUID} /success:enable /failure:enable. controls.notes: How CIS's position changed (from the HardeningKitty CIS lists and the ansible-lockdown v3.0.0 role): Win10 v1.6.1 (1809) set BOTH Script Block Logging and Transcription to Disabled. Win10 v1.12.0 and Win11 v1.0.0 set Script Block Logging Enabled and Transcription Disabled. Win11 v2.0.0 set both Enabled at L1. Win11 v3.0.0 and v4.0.0 keep both Enabled but move them to Level 2 (items 18.10.86.x in v3, 18.10.87.x in v4). MSB (23H2 through 25H2/26H2) enables Script Block Logging with EnableScriptBlockInvocationLogging=0. MSB does not configure transcription or module logging. Module logging for all modules ('*') is in neither CIS nor MSB; it is added to 'full' because it is common SOC guidance. When OutputDirectory is not set, transcripts go to each user's Documents folder; that folder may sync to OneDrive and the transcripts may contain secrets. Consider an OutputDirectory on a protected location. Script block logs (Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational, event 4104) can also contain secrets; consider Protected Event Logging. These keys affect Windows PowerShell 5.1 only. PowerShell 7 reads Software\Policies\Microsoft\PowerShellCore\... instead; set UseWindowsPowerShellPolicySetting=1 there to inherit.

controls.notes: MaxSize is a REG_DWORD in KB. The current EventLog.admx accepts 1028 to 2147483647 KB; its help text says 1 MB to 2 TB. 4194240 KB was the old Windows Server 2003 limit and is not the policy maximum. Keep values in multiples of 64 KB, because Event Viewer rounds to 64 KB. In practice, keep each log at or below about 4 GB. Retention is a REG_SZ. CIS expects "0", which means the policy 'Control Event Log behavior when the log file reaches its maximum size' is Disabled: the oldest events are overwritten, as Windows does by default. The option matchMode atLeast is meant for the MaxSize DWORDs; compare Retention as an exact string. MSB does not configure the Setup log or Retention. Left out: CIS 18.5.13 (L1) MSS WarningLevel <= 90 for the Security log (System\CurrentControlSet\Services\Eventlog\Security\WarningLevel), because it needs atMost semantics. Add it as its own control if wanted. Option title changed from 'Preporučeno' to 'Standardno', because level 1 (Osnovno) selects it and the old title clashed with the level name 'Preporučeno'.
